base_source: FY2025 audited cash flow statement: OCF $1,752.6M - Cboe Clear Europe clearing-member margin/default/interoperability fund line $528.5M + Section 31 fees payable paydown $181.8M removed = clean OCF $1,405.9M; - capex $71.0M - SBC $50.4M = $1,284.5M / 105.1M diluted shares = $12.22. Raw engine base was $15.52 (float-inflated); float-cleaned TTM through Q2 2026 is $9.41 (June-timing-depressed). See analysis.md.
method_range_note: Defensible bases span weighted IRR 8.6% (Tier D, float-cleaned TTM $9.41) to 12.0% (Tier C, float-inflated raw FY2025 $15.52); final uses float-cleaned FY2025 $12.22 at 10.2% (Tier C). No defensible base clears 15% at $292.25. See analysis.md.
moat_justification: Exclusive SPX/VIX index options franchise (highest-RPC flow in US options), liquidity network effects at ~30% options share, recurring Data Vantage revenue, 72% adj. EBITDA margin and net cash — against fungible multi-listed flow across 16 exchanges, volatility-cyclical volumes, 0DTE RPC dilution, and contractual (not statutory) index exclusivity.
name: Cboe Global Markets, Inc.
one_liner: Top-tier exchange franchise, moat 7/10, with real (float-cleaned) owner's earnings of $12.22/share — but at $292 (23.9x that base) the weighted IRR is 10.2%, well short of the 15% hurdle; it clears 15% only at <= ~$167, and with a margin of safety nearer $130-150.
